identity.notes: The official location page and active exact-address Toast storefront independently bind this row to Cordelia Fishbar at 550 Morse St NE. It is the same physical business as cordelia-fishbar-dc, not another Washington location: both rows share the name, domain, official location URL, and exact Toast storefront.

sources.excerpt: Official Cordelia Fishbar homepage links the current location and menu surfaces.
Official location page identifies Cordelia Fishbar at 550 Morse St NE, Washington, DC 20002, phone (202) 925-5020, with current hours and direct menu and ordering links.

Current official menu page exposes complete Dinner, Brunch, Happy Hour, Beverage, Raw Bar, and Dessert sections. Food and nonalcoholic products were inventoried; alcohol was excluded. Ingredient descriptions support only direct positive allergen claims, and no comprehensive allergen or cross-contact matrix is published here.
Current two-page Cordelia brunch PDF corroborates brunch food, raw bar, zero-proof drinks, and coffee service. Its footer has a raw-food warning but no item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.
Current official Cordelia dinner PDF linked from the menus page. The accessible official HTML supplied the complete dinner content.
Current beverage PDF corroborates zero-proof drinks, nonalcoholic beer, coffee, espresso drinks, and tea. It contains no comprehensive food-allergen matrix.
Current one-page dessert PDF corroborates the six-item dessert section and contains no allergen matrix.

Live official-linked Toast storefront is bound to pickup at 550 Morse Street NE. A complete category inspection covered small plates, large plates, sides, kids, and dessert; sold-out products remained in the current catalog and repeated featured/category placements were consolidated.

Toast exposes allergy-request modifier products for common allergens with a best-efforts accommodation note. These are diner-request controls, not product-to-allergen mappings, and were not treated as an allergen matrix.
Fresh official-domain and Bento-document searches surfaced current menu PDFs but no Cordelia allergen matrix or restaurant-issued cross-contact guide.
Exact-brand and exact-location searches corroborated the official site and Toast storefront and found no authoritative item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.
